Generates a preview image for a message that was not flagged as a detection. Useful for investigating benign messages. Returns a base64-encoded PNG screenshot of the email body.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier tag.; body (body)

name: Change email classification
description: Change email classification Submits a request to reclassify an email's disposition. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email-security/investigate/{investigate_id}/reclassify
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email-security/investigate/{investigate_id}/reclassify
Submits a request to reclassify an email's disposition. Use for reporting false positives or false negatives. Optionally provide the raw EML content for reanalysis. The reclassification is processed asynchronously.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier tag.; investigate_id (path); body (body)

name: Release messages from quarantine
description: Release messages from quarantine Delivers one or more quarantined messages to their intended recipients, for cases where a message was incorrectly quarantined. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email-security/investigate/release
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email-security/investigate/release
Delivers one or more quarantined messages to their intended recipients, for cases where a message was incorrectly quarantined. The response includes delivery status for each recipient.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier tag.; body (body) — A list of investigate IDs identifying the messages to release.

name: Get reclassify submissions
description: Get reclassify submissions Returns information for submissions made to reclassify emails. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email-security/submissions
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email-security/submissions
Returns information for submissions made to reclassify emails. Shows the status, outcome, and disposition changes for reclassification requests made by users or the security team. Useful for tracking false positive/negative reports.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier tag.
Optional: start (query) — The beginning of the search date range. Defaults to `now - 30 days`.; end (query) — The end of the search date range. Defaults to `now`.; type (query); submission_id (query); original_disposition (query); requested_disposition (query); outcome_disposition (query); status (query); query (query); escalated_from_user (query) — When true, return only submissions that were escalated by an end user (vs. by the security team). When false, return only submissions that were not escalated by an end user. When omitted, no filter is applied.; order (query) — Field to sort by.; direction (query) — The sorting direction.; page (query) — Current page within paginated list of results.; per_page (query) — The number of results per page. Maximum value is 1000.
